dockerfile:
FROM python:3.10-slim

# Install system dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    curl \
    unzip \
    supervisor \
    net-tools \
    openssh-server \
    wget \
    build-essential \
    gcc \
    g++ \
    make \
    libssl-dev \
    zlib1g-dev \
    libbz2-dev \
    libreadline-dev \
    libsqlite3-dev \
    libffi-dev \
    liblzma-dev \
    tk-dev \
    uuid-dev \
    --no-install-recommends && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Supervisor
RUN cat > /etc/supervisord.conf << 'EOF'
[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/var/log/supervisor/supervisord.log
pidfile=/var/run/supervisord.log
[program:sshd]
command=/usr/sbin/sshd -D
EOF

# Configure SSH
RUN cat >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config << 'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 60
ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF

RUN mkdir -p /var/run/sshd && \
    mkdir -p /var/log/supervisor && \
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/UsePAM yes/UsePAM no/g' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Python dependencies
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir numpy mcp simsimd
usage_entry_command: python -c "import simsimd; print('SimSIMD version:', simsimd.__version__); print('Capabilities:', simsimd.get_capabilities())"

    gcc \
    g++ \
    make \
    libgl1 \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libsm6 \
    libxext6 \
    libxrender1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN pip install numpy scipy matplotlib opencv-python

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \

dockerfile:
FROM ubuntu:22.04

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    python3 \
    python3-pip \
    supervisor \
    net-tools \
    openssh-server \
    gcc \
    g++ \
    make \
    wget \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN pip3 install numpy mcp
usage_entry_command: which sshd && python3 -c "import numpy, mcp; print('ok')"
